cs.t: Logitech G12 I think it's called (gaming fullsize keyboard with a blue togglable backlight and extra rows of function keys on the left side), had it for years and it works great, no reason to contribute more to our global trash and pollution problem by buying a marginal upgrade. qwerty, because my home keyboard isn't the only one I use and I don't want to bother with changing to dvorak or colemak or whatever (I used those two at various points), and even though I'm typing somewhere almost every day, including occasional transcriptions, I'm fine with 70-80 wpm and and having to reach a bit.
